title: The post charge-off sale harness pack for the debt sale handover is not specified
source: Template and Rules v1 §R7.2 and §R9; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 41 and 43 (lines 2896 to 2899 and 2949 to 2950) and the S6 block at lines 1397 to 1403; Temporal and Drools Design Text Extract v1 lines 1555 and 1815 to 1819; legacy RWB-E6-028 sections Data, Endpoints, Screen and states and Test cases; ownership.json api and tables
description: (a) No source read gives the harness environment and its base hosts, the fixture layout, the synthetic case keys beyond the RW-YYYY-NNNNNN form (DF-CAS-002), the synthetic write-off and lot keys, the population size, the two inside-limit and one above-limit amounts, the write-off committee limit itself, the business date, the evidence format and retention, or the pass or fail gate. The legacy story names no synthetic key, no amount, no limit and no business date, and the Architecture v5 slides give the service, the topic and the queue only. (b) No source read publishes a write-off read or a write-off sale operation. ownership.json gives POST /write-offs/{writeOffId}/committee-decision to S7 and nothing else on the write-off, so the population has to be identified through the P3 case read, the P7 decision log and DP09 Debt sale read through P1, and the handover has to be driven by S6's own published lot operation POST /debt-sale-lots with GET /debt-sale-lots/{lotId} as its read, which is what Architecture v5 line 1397 names as GET/POST /lots.
evidence: Read and confirmed: Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 lines 2896 to 2899 (S5, S6 and S7 service rows) and 2949 to 2950 (events 23 LotAwarded and 24 WriteOffApproved), lines 1397 to 1403 (S6 REST GET/POST /lots, POST /lots/{id}/award, DebtSaleWorkflow saga pivot = transfer); Temporal and Drools Design Text Extract v1 lines 1555 and 1815 to 1819 (point of no return and strict mode); Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 lines 342, 343, 344, 346, 351, 360, 362 and 363; legacy RWB-E6-028 lines 10889 to 10908 and 10926 to 10935, which name no synthetic key, amount, limit or business date; ownership.json api entries for POST /write-offs/{writeOffId}/committee-decision, GET /approvals, POST /approvals/{approvalId}/approve, GET /decision-log, GET /debt-sale-lots/{lotId}, POST /debt-sale-lots, GET /data-products/{productCode}/records and GET /me/session, and tables write_off (S7), debt_sale_lot and debt_sale_account (S6), recovery_case (P3), decision_log_entry, approval and rule_row (P7)
proposed: Agree the fixture layout, the synthetic case, write-off and lot keys, the amount set and the write-off committee limit, the business date, the evidence retention and the gate at the wave 4 entry check, and hold each of them as configuration; record that the write-off read and the write-off sale operation do not exist, so the population is asserted through the case read, the decision log and DP09 and the handover is driven by S6's published lot operation
